newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLISH COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIP CLOSE SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLISH COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIP CLOSE SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of rain-affected English county championship matches on Friday:
The Oval (London): Surrey v Nottinghamshire - no play.
At Southend: Derbyshire v Essex - no play today. Derbyshire 142 (M.Ilott 7-59), Essex 157-2 (P.Prichard 71 not out, S.Law 69 not out)
At Swansea: Glamorgan 172 and 183-9 declared (S.James 82 not out, M.Maynard 61; M.Robinson 4-42), Sussex 54 (Waqar Younis 8-17) and 10-0.
At Leicester: Leicestershire v Warwickshire - no play.
At Luton: Northamptonshire v Gloucestershire -no play.
At Headingley (Leeds): Middlesex 150-3 (M.Ramprakash 76 not out ) v Yorkshire.
